summary: Phase-2 full-stack testing of Kabul Star Academy. Backend: created pytest suite (35 tests) covering courses CRUD/archive, public registration + approve/reject, user create/patch/suspend, classes + per-role visibility, attendance, lessons, homework, exams, message approval workflow, and all 401/403 role guards, plus auth/security playbook checks (bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookies, CORS+credentials, 5-fail lockout->429, seed_admin update). 35/35 pass. Frontend: verified homepage + Register nav link, public registration form -> pending -> manager approve (student account + credentials toast), manager all 9 tabs, course add, class create with teacher+students, message approval via UI, settings save, logout; teacher all 8 tabs + homework/exam/message create; student all 7 tabs with real data (lesson, attendance %, homework, exams, messages) and role-based redirect /dashboard/manager -> /dashboard/student. Found 2 HIGH functional bugs caused by missing backend read-access for teacher/student roles, plus archived-class leakage.

critical.issue: Manager-only (403 for teacher). Teacher UI calls this for the attendance roster, 'My Students' tab and message recipients, so teachers can NEVER mark attendance or address a message to a student. Needs a teacher-scoped endpoint (e.g. GET /api/classes/{id}/students, or allow teacher access filtered to students in their own classes).

Returns only id/email/name/role. Student dashboard reads user.course_id (StudentOverviewTab / StudentCourseTab), so 'My Course' is always 'Not assigned', overall progress always 0% and the whole course pathway shows every course as 'Upcoming' even after the manager assigns a course. Add course_id/current_level/progress/phone/branch to /auth/me (or add GET /api/users/me).

minor.issue: Does not filter archived classes. DELETE /api/classes/{id} only sets archived=true, but list_classes has no {'archived': {'$ne': True}} filter, so archived classes still appear for manager/teacher/student (student 'Today's lesson' rendered a lesson from an archived class). /courses/public filters correctly - make classes consistent.
Returns 200 {ok:true} even when the class id does not exist (no matched_count check), unlike DELETE /api/courses/{cid} which 404s.
Accepts entries=[] and returns 201 {'ok':true,'count':0}, which makes the UI show 'Attendance saved' when nothing was recorded. Reject empty entries with 400 (or at least surface count in the UI).
entries is List[dict] - no Pydantic model, so a malformed entry missing 'student_id'/'status' raises a raw KeyError (500) instead of 422. Define an AttendanceEntry model.
recipient_ids is not validated against the selected class roster and an empty list is accepted, so a teacher can create/approve a message no one will ever receive.

ui_bugs.issue: After selecting a class that has students, the panel still shows 'Select a class with students to mark attendance.' and 0 student rows render, yet clicking 'Save attendance' shows a false 'Attendance saved' toast. Root cause: api.get('/users?role=student') 403s for teachers and the error is swallowed (.catch(() => {})), so roster = [].
'My Students' tab is permanently empty ('No students in your classes yet.') for the same 403 reason, even when the manager assigned students.

Compose dialog recipient list always shows 'Select a class to see students.' even after picking a class; api.get('/users?role=student') on line ~354 has no .catch so the 403 surfaces as an unhandled promise rejection (window pageerror: 'Request failed with status code 403'). Messages therefore get created with recipient_ids=[] and never reach any student.
'My Course' shows 'Not assigned' and pathway marks all 15 courses 'Upcoming' / progress 0% even after manager PATCH sets course_id. Depends on user.course_id which /auth/me never returns.

The class <Select> in 'Add today's lesson' has no data-testid (only lesson-title / lesson-save exist), and submitting without a class selected produced no visible validation error. Add data-testid="lesson-class" and inline validation.

Entire student dashboard file contains ZERO data-testid attributes (no testids on stat cards, attendance rows, homework/exam/message cards, profile fields), so student-side assertions can only be done via raw text. Also manager OverviewTab stat cards have no testids.

integration_issues.flow: Teacher marks attendance -> student attendance history
integration_issues.issue: Cannot be completed through the UI at all (roster empty). Verified working only via direct API calls, which confirms the break is the teacher's missing student-read permission, not the attendance endpoint.

integration_issues.flow: Teacher message -> manager approval -> student inbox
integration_issues.issue: Manager approve/reject buttons and the student inbox work correctly, but the teacher UI cannot attach recipients, so the end-to-end flow only works when recipient_ids are injected via API.

issues: document.title is still the boilerplate 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'Kabul Star English Language Academy'; no per-route titles/meta description.
Unauthenticated visitors trigger a GET /api/auth/me that returns 401 on every page load, logging console errors. Skip the probe when no session cookie/flag exists.
Stat cards render with no loading skeleton and silently fall back to all zeros on any API error (.catch sets every stat to 0), hiding real failures from the manager.
Course pathway duration reads '1 months' (should be '1 month'); every row shows the same 'Upcoming' badge so there is no visual current-level marker.

action_items: CRITICAL: give teachers a way to read the students of their own classes (new GET /api/classes/{id}/students or widen /api/users for teachers scoped to their class rosters) and point TeacherAttendanceTab / TeacherStudentsTab / TeacherMessagesTab at it. Attendance marking is completely unusable today.
HIGH: include course_id (and current_level/progress/branch/phone) in GET /api/auth/me so the student 'My Course', progress bar and course pathway work.
Filter archived classes out of GET /api/classes (all three role branches) and make DELETE /api/classes 404 on unknown id.
Reject POST /api/attendance with empty entries (400) and model entries with a Pydantic AttendanceEntry so malformed payloads return 422 instead of 500.

Add .catch/error-state handling to every api.get in teacher/tabs.jsx (line ~354 causes an unhandled rejection) so permission failures surface as a toast instead of an empty panel with a false success.
Add data-testid attributes across student/tabs.jsx, plus lesson-class select and manager overview stat cards.
Set a real document title / meta description and stop probing /api/auth/me when there is no session.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_academy.py: role-based read permissions are inconsistent - teachers can list their classes but cannot resolve the student ids inside them, which makes attendance/messages unusable. The permission model needs a class-scoped student read.
routes_academy.py list_classes(): archived flag is written by DELETE but never used by any read query - dead soft-delete.
routes_academy.py AttendanceMark.entries: List[dict] bypasses validation; e['student_id'] / e['status'] will KeyError -> 500.
server.py /auth/me returns a hand-picked subset of user fields that the student dashboard depends on; either return the sanitized user document or add a dedicated profile endpoint.
frontend/manager/tabs.jsx is 766 lines and teacher/tabs.jsx 505 lines - split per-tab into separate files (>700-line guideline).
Several api.get(...) calls have no .catch and no error UI state (teacher/tabs.jsx:354, student/tabs.jsx:29-34), so 4xx/5xx render as silently empty panels.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (manager + student + public flows pass; teacher attendance/students/message-recipients broken)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py + conftest.py (35 tests, all green; run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so the sequential E2E flow is intentionally kept inside the single class TestAcademyFlow. Class TEST_UI_Class_QA1 links Demo Teacher + Demo Student with lesson/homework/exam/attendance/message data already in place - reuse it. Re-verify after fixes: (1) teacher Attendance tab renders the roster and att-{id}-present buttons appear, (2) teacher Compose dialog lists recipients, (3) teacher 'My Students' tab is non-empty, (4) student 'My Course' shows the assigned course + non-zero progress, (5) archived classes disappear from GET /api/classes. Note the preview edge proxy answers OPTIONS preflight itself and rewrites CORS headers, so app-level CORS must be asserted against http://localhost:8001.
rca_of_the_issue: Both HIGH/CRITICAL bugs are missing role-scoped read APIs rather than UI defects. (1) Teacher attendance: teacher/tabs.jsx builds its roster with `students.filter(s => cls.student_ids.includes(s.id))` after `api.get('/users?role=student')`, but routes_academy.list_users is guarded by require_role('manager'), so the teacher gets 403; the .catch(() => {}) swallows it and roster stays empty -> the 'Select a class with students' placeholder renders, save posts entries=[] and the backend happily returns 201 count:0 producing a false 'Attendance saved' toast. Repro: log in as teacher@kabulstar.edu -> Attendance -> select TEST_UI_Class_QA1 -> no student rows. (2) Student My Course: StudentOverviewTab/StudentCourseTab match `courses.find(c => c.id === user.course_id)` where user comes from GET /api/auth/me, which returns only id/email/name/role - course_id is always undefined. Repro: as manager PATCH /api/users/{studentId} {course_id: <Book 3 id>} (returns 200, persisted), then log in as that student -> 'My Course: Not assigned', progress 0%. Mitigation: expose class-scoped students to teachers and return the student's course_id from /auth/me.
